description_en: Invoke an already created API in the data service
description_zh: 对数据服务中已创建的API进行调用
name: QueryDataService

parameters.help_en: The API ID in the data service. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144980.html
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en:
The query conditions for the data service, passed in as Key-Value pairs. This is a map-type string. Here, Key is the name of the request parameter, and Value is the value of the request parameter. Keys and Values must appear in pairs.

Note:

When the operator of the request parameter is set to enumeration filter, the value can contain multiple values. In this case, the format of the value is a JSON list. For example: `area=["East China","North China","South China"]`     

For dates, different formats are provided based on the type:

    - Year: 2019

    - Quarter: 2019Q1

    - Month: 201901 (with leading zero)
    
    - Week: 2019-52

    - Day: 20190101

    - Hour: 14:00:00 (minutes and seconds are 00)
    
    - Minute: 14:12:00 (seconds are 00)

    - Second: 14:34:34
parameters.help_zh:
数据服务的查询条件，以Key和Value的形式传入。map类型的字符串。其中，Key为请求参数的参数名，Value为请求参数的参数值。Key和Value必须成对出现。

说明：

请求参数的操作符设置为枚举筛选时支持value包含多个值，此时value值的格式是JSON形式的List。例如： `area=["华东","华北","华南"] `     

对于日期，根据类型不同，提供不同的入参格式：

    - 年：2019

    - 季：2019Q1

    - 月：201901  （携带0）
    
    - 周：2019-52

    - 日：20190101

    - 时：14:00:00 （分、秒为00）
    
    - 分：14:12:00 （秒为00）

    - 秒：14:34:34
parameters.name: conditions

parameters.help_en: A list of parameter names to be returned, as a List-type string
parameters.help_zh: 返回参数的参数名列表，List 类型字符串
parameters.name: return_fields

Result.description_en: Returns the result of the interface query

Aggregator.description_en: Aggregation operator. Only present for measure fields, such as SUM, AVG, and MAX
Aggregator.description_zh: 聚合操作符。度量字段才会有，例如SUM、AVG和MAX

Column.description_en: Field name, corresponding to the physical table field name
Column.description_zh: 字段名，对应物理表字段名

DataType.description_en: The data type of the field. Common types include number, string, date, datetime, time, and geographic
DataType.description_zh:
字段的数据类型。一般有
number、string、date、datetime、time、geographic

Granularity.description_en:
The granularity of the dimension field.
This field is returned only when the requested field is a date or geographic dimension, with the following possible values:

Date granularity: yearRegion (year), monthRegion (month), weekRegion (week), dayRegion (day), hourRegion (hour), minRegion (minute), secRegion (second)

Geographic granularity: COUNTRY (country level), PROVINCE (province level), CITY (city level), XIAN (district/county level), REGION (region)
Granularity.description_zh:
维度字段的粒度。
当请求字段为日期维度或地理维度字段，才会返回该字段，取值范围：

日期粒度：yearRegion（年）、 monthRegion（月）、weekRegion（周）、dayRegion（日）、hourRegion（时）、minRegion（分）、secRegion（秒）

地理信息粒度：COUNTRY（国际级）、PROVINCE（省级）、CITY（市级）、XIAN（区县）、REGION（区域）

Label.description_en: Alias for the field, serving as the key in the map data row of the values parameter
Label.description_zh: 字段别名，结果参数values中map数据行的key

Type.description_en: Field type, used to distinguish between dimension and measure fields
Type.description_zh: 字段类型，用于区分是字段类型为维度或度量字段

Sql.description_en: The SQL of the query request
Sql.example: SELECT COMPANY_T_1_.`area` AS D_AREA_2_, COMPANY_T_1_.`city` AS D_CITY_3_, SUM(COMPANY_T_1_.`profit_amt`) AS D_PROFIT_4_ FROM `quickbi_test`.`company_sales_record_copy` AS COMPANY_T_1_ WHERE COMPANY_T_1_.`area` LIKE '%华东%' GROUP BY COMPANY_T_1_.`area`, COMPANY_T_1_.`city` HAVING SUM(COMPANY_T_1_.`order_amt`) > 1 LIMIT 0, 10

items.description_en:
Rows and columns of the returned data.

This parameter is a List<Map> structure, where each Map represents a row of data. The Key in the Map corresponds to the Headers#Label field
items.description_zh:
返回数据的行和列。

此参数为List<Map>结构，每个Map即一行数据。其中Map中的Key对应 Headers#Label字段

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Possible values:

true: The request was successful

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功

false：请求失败
